headline: Butterfield Bermuda: Round 1 tees off at Port Royal, field of 120
whyCareReason: Round 1 is underway Thursday 22 October. Adam Schenk defends his title. Purse $6 million.
teaser: 120 players, $6 million purse, 500 FedExCup points. Golf Channel live coverage 1-4 p.m. ET.
story: Round 1 of the Butterfield Bermuda Championship opened Thursday morning, 22 October, at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, Bermuda. Play started at 7:35 a.m. local time off both the 1st and 10th tees across a 120-player field. The par-71 Robert Trent Jones layout measures 6,828 yards along the Atlantic. The purse is $6 million, with the winner earning $1.08 million and 500 FedExCup points. Golf Channel carries live television coverage Thursday through Sunday from 1:00 to 4:00 p.m. ET. Defending champion Adam Schenk aims to repeat, alongside top-ranked Corey Conners (world No. 61) and teenage amateur Miles Russell.
stakes: FedExCup Fall points are on the line as 120 players battle windy Atlantic conditions in Southampton.
rivalryAngle: A full-field test in Bermuda brings FedExCup Fall points back into focus.
